errors.files_busy: Files are busy. Wait for the current file operation or addition, then try again.
errors.shared_files: Other torrents use these files. Refresh the list and include them in the move.
errors.destination_conflict: Different source files would occupy the same destination. Choose another folder or move these torrents separately.
errors.destination_in_use: Another torrent uses files at this destination. Choose another folder to keep its files unchanged.
errors.destination_exists: Files already exist at the destination. Open Move files and choose Use files there to verify and use them.
errors.move_failed: The files could not be moved. Open Move files, choose the folder that now holds the files, and choose Use files there.
errors.move_interrupted: The move was interrupted. Open Move files, choose the folder that now holds the files, and choose Use files there.
errors.move_uncertain: The move could not be confirmed. Exit and reopen TinyTorrent before using Move files to recover the actual folder. If Exit reports an unresolved operation, choose Exit anyway.
errors.recovery_required: The operation could not be confirmed. Check the torrent's current state before trying again.
errors.registration_failed: Windows could not change TinyTorrent's startup or file-handling registration.
errors.invalid_trackers: Enter one HTTP, HTTPS or UDP tracker URL per line.
errors.unknown: The operation could not be completed.
errors.torrent_error: The torrent stopped because of an error.
errors.storage_failed: Saved download state could not be read or written. Check the engine data folder and try again.
errors.language_unsaved: Your language choice is active but has not been saved. Restarting TinyTorrent will use the last saved language.
errors.invalid_destination: Choose an existing, writable download folder.
errors.incomplete_add: Choose a source and a download folder.
errors.invalid_source: Enter a valid magnet link or choose a valid torrent file.
errors.starting: TinyTorrent is still loading saved downloads. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid_limits: Enter a speed limit between 0 and 2,097,151 KiB/s.
errors.preview_expired: This preview expired. Choose Add again to reacquire it with your choices.
errors.invalid_priorities: Choose at least one file and a valid download priority.
errors.alias_conflict: This torrent conflicts with another download. Review the existing torrent before adding it.
errors.preview_failed: Torrent metadata could not be obtained. Try again.

connection.overload: Too many commands are pending. Try again shortly.
connection.uncertain: The connection was lost. Reconnecting to confirm the current state.
connection.missing: Engine.exe was not found beside the application.

preferences.downloads_hint: Where new torrents are saved and how they are added.
preferences.power_hint: Keep the PC awake for transfers, and look for new versions.
preferences.speed_hint: Limits for all torrents together. 0 means unlimited.
preferences.alternative_hint: Replace the normal limits while Alternative limits is on in the status bar, or during a scheduled period. 0 means unlimited.
preferences.queue_hint: Torrents beyond these numbers wait in the queue.
preferences.seeding_hint: Reaching either limit pauses the torrent and keeps its files. 0 means unlimited.
preferences.show_add_hint: When off, TinyTorrent adds torrents to the default folder without asking.
preferences.interface_hint: Send all torrent traffic through one adapter, for example a VPN.
preferences.port_mapping: Forward the port on my router (UPnP / NAT-PMP)
preferences.mapping_hint: More peers can connect when the router forwards the port.
preferences.port_hint: Other peers connect to TinyTorrent on this port.
preferences.prevent_sleep: Prevent sleep while downloading on mains power
preferences.prevent_sleep_seeding: Also prevent sleep while seeding on mains power
preferences.schedule_active: Repeats each week in local time.
preferences.schedule_inactive: Off · Saved periods aren't being applied. You can still edit them.
preferences.timeline_hint: Drag empty time to add. Drag a period or its handles to move or resize it on all its days. Snaps to 15 minutes and saves on release; Esc cancels.
preferences.preview_hint: Drag the preview to move it, or either edge to resize. Save applies the period; Esc during a drag restores its previous times.
preferences.timeline_name: Weekly schedule. {0}. Use arrow keys to choose a day and time, Space to select a period, and Enter to add or edit. Esc cancels.
preferences.duplicate_period: A period with these days, times and limits already exists. Choose different values or cancel and edit it in Saved periods.
preferences.defaults_detail: Choose the app that opens torrent files and magnet links.
preferences.magnet_default: Torrent files open with TinyTorrent. Choose TinyTorrent for magnet links in Windows Settings.
preferences.torrent_default: Magnet links open with TinyTorrent. Choose TinyTorrent for torrent files in Windows Settings.
preferences.invalid_number: Enter a valid non-negative number. Counts and minutes must be whole numbers.
preferences.invalid_port: Enter a whole number from 1 to 65,535.
preferences.schedule_hint: Repeats in local time. Normal limits apply outside periods; pause takes precedence on overlap. Overnight periods end the following day.
preferences.invalid_period: Choose at least one start day and valid start and end times.
preferences.appearance_hint: Choose the language and colors of TinyTorrent.
preferences.show_splash: Show the splash screen while opening
preferences.start_in_tray_hint: Only the notification-area icon appears. Opening TinyTorrent again shows the window.
